subject: general
question: On 6 November 2025, where was the Indian Navy’s survey ship INS Ikshak commissioned?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kochi**__.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
 __ 
• The **Indian Navy** officially commissioned its second **Survey Vessel (Large)**, **INS Ikshak**, on **6 November 2025**. 
• The commissioning ceremony was held at the **Naval Base** in **Kochi**, attended by senior military officials and dignitaries from the **Ministry of Defence**. 
• **INS Ikshak** is the second of **four** such vessels being built under the **SVL Project** by **Garden Reach Shipbuilders & Engineers (GRSE)**, **Kolkata**, in collaboration with **L&T Shipbuilding**. 
• The vessel's name, '**Ikshak**', translates to '**Guide**', representing the ship's primary mission of ensuring safe passage for mariners through precise maritime mapping. 
• This ship is a testament to **India's** growing maritime strength and its commitment to the **Make in India** initiative, boasting over **80% indigenous content** by cost. 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
 __ 
• **Survey Vessel Large (SVL) Project:** 
• The project was initiated to replace the existing **Sandhayak-class** survey ships with more advanced platforms. 
• The contract for **four** **SVL** ships was signed in **October 2018** between the **Ministry of Defence** and **GRSE**. 
• **INS Sandhayak**, the first ship of this class, was commissioned earlier in **February 2024** at **Visakhapatnam**. 
• **Technical Capabilities and Features:** 
• The ship has a length of **110 meters** and a displacement of approximately **3,400 tons**. 
• It is equipped with highly sophisticated **hydrographic** equipment, including **Multi-beam Echo Sounders** and **Autonomous Underwater Vehicles (AUVs)**. 
• The vessel is powered by **two diesel engines** and can maintain a cruising speed of **14 knots**, with a maximum speed of **18 knots**. 
• **Operational Roles:** 
• The primary role involves conducting full-scale coastal and deep-water **hydrographic surveys** of **ports**, **harbors**, and **Exclusive Economic Zones (EEZ)**. 
• It is designed to collect **oceanographic** and **geophysical** data for both **military** and **civilian** applications. 
• In times of emergency, the ship can be repurposed for **Humanitarian Assistance and Disaster Relief (HADR)** and can function as a **hospital ship**. 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**
 
• The induction of **INS Ikshak** into the **Southern Naval Command** will significantly enhance the **Indian Navy's** capability to map the seabed in the strategic **Indian Ocean Region (IOR)**. 
• The ship's advanced sensors and **Remotely Operated Vehicles (ROVs)** allow for high-resolution underwater data collection, which is vital for **submarine operations** and **maritime security**. 
• The **SVL** ships carry **four Survey Motor Boats**, which act as force multipliers during shallow water survey operations. 
• The commissioning reinforces **India's** role as a **Net Security Provider** and a leader in **hydrography** in the **Indo-Pacific** region. </ul
